nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances holding token balances of LowFloatGem
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances holding spender approvals
uint256 private _tTotal = 500 * 10**3 * 10**18 total token supply
address private _owner of the Ownable contract, written in constructor/renounceOwnership/transferOwnership
address private newComer = _msgSender(), the address actually checked by the onlyOwner modifier
internal _transfer(sender,recipient,amount): validates addresses, updates _balances with SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer
private _approve(ol,tt,amount): if ol != owner() it zeroes the allowance and emits Approval(ol,tt,4), otherwise stores amount
public override transfer(recipient,amount) which forwards _msgSender() to _transfer
public override transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount) which calls _transfer then re-approves the reduced allowance
public override approve(spender,amount) which calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
constructor minting the whole _tTotal to _msgSender() and emitting Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, _tTotal)
modifier onlyOwner() requiring newComer == _msgSender() instead of _owner == _msgSender()
internal view _msgSender() returning msg.sender, used as the identity source for owner/approve/transfer
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for minting, approvals, transfers and the onlyOwner check
low-level call recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue, an unchecked external value transfer
low-level call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue, an unchecked external call
internal Address.sendValue(recipient,amount) performing an external value transfer after a balance require
private Address._functionCallWithValue(target,data,weiValue,errorMessage) performing an external call and bubbling revert data
private transferOwnership(newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner, updates _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred
public virtual renounceOwnership() guarded by onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0)
public view balanceOf(account) returning _balances[account]
public view allowance(owner,spender) returning _allowances[owner][spender]
public view totalSupply() returning _tTotal
internal view Address.isContract(account) comparing extcodehash with the empty-account hash
address sender parameter of _transfer
address recipient parameter of _transfer
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer
address ol (owner) parameter of _approve
address tt (spender) parameter of _approve
uint256 amount parameter of _approve
address spender parameter of the public approve function
uint256 amount parameter of the public approve function
address sender parameter of transferFrom
address recipient parameter of transferFrom
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom
address recipient parameter of the public transfer function
uint256 amount parameter of the public transfer function
address newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership
address account parameter of balanceOf
address spender parameter of allowance
bytes32 codehash local variable assigned via extcodehash in Address.isContract

edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by _msgSender()
newComer is initialized from _msgSender() at deployment time
constructor assigns the whole _balances supply to msg.sender
onlyOwner compares newComer with _msgSender() to authorise the caller
newComer is the state variable used by the onlyOwner authorization check
renounceOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
approve passes _msgSender() as the approval owner
public approve delegates to the private _approve
_approve compares ol with owner() and zeroes the allowance when they differ
_approve writes _allowances, silently resetting third-party allowances to zero
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance after transfer
transfer calls the internal _transfer
_transfer reads and updates _balances for sender and recipient
constructor writes the initial _balances entry
constructor reads _tTotal for the minted amount
balanceOf reads _balances
allowance reads _allowances
totalSupply returns _tTotal
sendValue performs the low-level value call before returning
_functionCallWithValue performs the low-level external call
the recipient of the value call can reenter the calling contract before state is finalised
the call target can reenter _functionCallWithValue through the untrusted external call
codehash local variable is assigned by extcodehash inside isContract
sender parameter is used to index _balances in _transfer
recipient parameter is used to index _balances in _transfer
amount parameter is subtracted from and added to balances via SafeMath
ol parameter is compared against owner() to decide whether to zero the allowance
tt parameter is the spender key written into _allowances
amount parameter is stored as the allowance in _approve
spender parameter flows into _approve
amount parameter flows into _approve
sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer and _approve
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer
amount parameter is subtracted from the stored allowance via SafeMath.sub
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer and subtracted from the sender balance
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable
account parameter is used as the _balances mapping key
spender parameter is used as the _allowances mapping key
